report:
Reviewed the complete claim, sole ordinary implementation association (local_syms/fns.rs), three ordinary harness tests and explicit TODO test. Independently compared all three historical implementation/test source snapshots with current files: exact byte matches. The prior rationale remains appropriate but describes partial coverage, not complete implementation verification.

Source assessment: open_owner copies the trait/impl binder and retains its generic identities; trait Self uses binder.value.self_param, impl Self uses binder.value.self_ty. sig installs owner parameters and Self before checking method parameters, appends method generics after owner generics, and builds Binder::new from the resulting signature and parameter list. The no-owner branch correctly starts empty. This establishes the associated-function construction path and its parameter ordering from source, without asserting independently verified universal copy/open behavior.

The full annotated assertions provide complementary evidence: trait_items_have_stable_symbols_and_owner_identity compares the method binder generic slice to the owning trait items binder and checks item ownership; trait_and_impl_signatures_share_complete_generic_binders checks Self-plus-T and impl-T binder sizes and equality of repeated tuple parameter types; associated_items_reuse_owner_generics_and_bodies_resolve_fields checks the impl method generic count, receiver owner, owner argument/return type equality, and a diagnostic-free resolved field body. These would detect replacement/mismatched identities in the covered examples. Captured fixture helpers establish actual parsed crate setup and callback execution, rather than opaque verification wrappers.

The empty types_binder_owner_parameters TODO is not behavioral evidence. It explicitly retains direct copy/open identity checks and owner-plus-method generic coverage across all associated item kinds. Those require identity-comparing fixtures across copy/open operations and a trait/impl plus associated-kind matrix, with the corresponding associated-signature paths available; existing tests do not provide that matrix or direct copy invariance. Binder value/parameter identity preservation outside the demonstrated function path remains deferred under that explicit gap. No N/A entries exist. Accept this unchanged, visible partial-coverage accounting without claiming the deferred checks have passed.

Execution: personally ran review start, review read and the exact-byte comparison; no behavioral tests or build were executed by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and root build are separate baseline execution, not proof of these harness cases. No source edits or reproduced failures.
